scripts.build: bun run build:snapback && bun run build:supabase && bun run build:convex && bun run build:convex-realtime && bun run build:sqlite
scripts.build:snapback: bun --bun node_modules/.bin/vite build --config vite.config.ts --mode snapback --outDir dist/snapback && bun scripts/prerender.mjs --mode snapback --out-dir dist/snapback
scripts.build:supabase: bun --bun node_modules/.bin/vite build --config vite.config.ts --mode supabase --outDir dist/supabase && bun scripts/prerender.mjs --mode supabase --out-dir dist/supabase
scripts.build:convex: bun --bun node_modules/.bin/vite build --config vite.config.ts --mode convex --outDir dist/convex && bun scripts/prerender.mjs --mode convex --out-dir dist/convex
scripts.build:convex-realtime: bun --bun node_modules/.bin/vite build --config vite.config.ts --mode convex-realtime --outDir dist/convex-realtime && bun scripts/prerender.mjs --mode convex-realtime --out-dir dist/convex-realtime
scripts.build:sqlite: bun --bun node_modules/.bin/vite build --config vite.config.ts --mode sqlite --outDir dist/sqlite && bun scripts/prerender.mjs --mode sqlite --out-dir dist/sqlite
